description: Store, read or erase named values that persist in Photoshop between sessions (Application.putCustomOptions, getCustomOptions and eraseCustomOptions), for keeping settings across calls

action.description: get the values, set (replace) them, or erase them

persistent.description: set: keep after Photoshop quits. Default true

values.description: set: { name: string, number or boolean }. Names are letters, digits and underscores

name: manage_script_options
title: Manage Script Options
